semantic.justification: Task6764KT adds a real Canvas text device consumed structurally by native style CalcBoundRect/UserDrawEntry,without a VCL-to-SVX import. Actual Font values select CSS family,weight and posture;weight/posture projection follows native SVGAttributeWriter,including SEMILIGHT400 and unknown400. Canvas text is laid out from exact UTF16 substrings at the host boundary. Real fontBoundingBoxAscent/Descent supply original TOP/BASELINE/BOTTOM offsets;unsupported metrics are not replaced with fabricated baselines. Actual advance widths are rounded to integer and ink is enclosed in native closed-edge Rectangle values. Browser floor/ceil and Canvas shaping/metrics are host-owned,not native approxValue or raster parity. The consumed style-font path requires positive height and zero stored average width;arbitrary native horizontal font matching is explicitly unsupported. Device fixtures prove protocol behavior;Chromium witness separately consumes actual Writer preview items and bundled fonts with explicit supplied Latin ScriptInfo. EditEngine CheckScript,full SetupEntry decoration/color,physical cmap/face selection and live dropdown integration remain unfinished. No broad parity promotion.
